verdict.rationale: The networking docs describe a client–server architecture with replication, which implies game logic runs authoritatively on a server. Command-line arguments and cook/build tooling also customize how the engine runs. However, no evidence explicitly documents a dedicated-server build target or a headless, no-rendering runtime mode. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dedicated-server or server-only build targets, headless/no-rendering launch mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless server deployment.
